node.statement: Claim 1.1: The integrand equals R^(1)_{μν}R^{(1)μν} - β(R^(1))², where R^(1)_{μν} is the linearised Ricci tensor and R^(1)} the linearised Ricci scalar. The linearised Riemann tensor is R^(1)_{μνρσ} = (1/2)(∂_ν∂_ρ h_{μσ} + ∂_μ∂_σ h_{νρ} - ∂_μ∂_ρ h_{νσ} - ∂_ν∂_σ h_{μρ}). Contracting gives 2R^(1)_{μν} = ∂_λ∂_μ h^λ_ν + ∂_λ∂_ν h^λ_μ - ∂_μ∂_ν h - □h_{μν}, and R^(1) = ∂_μ∂_ν h^{μν} - □h. [Refs: Wald §4.4, Zee IX.4 eq.(1)]
